verdict.rationale: The evidence only covers Klaviyo's MCP server, which lets external AI agents (Claude, Cursor) query and act on Klaviyo data—this is an external-agent integration, not native in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced to the user inside Klaviyo's own UI. No evidence pack item describes built-in analytics AI, predictive suggestions, or in-app insight generation. Missing for 10: any documentation of native AI-driven insights/suggestions surfaced within Klaviyo's own dashboard or reporting UI.
